meaning:
§ Chisleu = "his confidence"
the 9th month of the calendar corresponding to Nov-Dec

elsewhere.note: The words of Nehemiah the son of Hacaliah. Now in the month Chislev, in the twentieth year, as I was in Susa the palace,
In the fourth year of king Darius, Yahweh’s word came to Zechariah in the fourth day of the ninth month, the month of Chislev.
